paragraphs.text: Haktos is a legendary warrior of Akros on Theros .

Famously invulnerable to almost everything, Haktos' one weakness has yet to be found. Haktos can be seen wearing light armor, bracers, shinguards, and a red cape, and wielding a spear. He has a strong, athletic build, light brown skin, and long, curly dark brown hair. He once fought a hydra , a tale that has become legendary and is now repeated in the starfield of Nyx. Perynes is his beloved lifelong companion.
